messages:
Noah (CSM): Starting kickoff for Lattice Med onboarding. Goals: secure staging integration, observability hooks, and a concise enablement for their support engineers. Looping in Aisha, Ravi, Clara, Diego.

Aisha (Solutions Eng): I can own API integration and initial smoke tests. Need staging repo access + sample prompts. Who's the Nebula contact? (or Lattice point person)

Noah (CSM): Contact is Marco Chen (Head of Platform). I'll intro and request a small corpus of representative prompts today.

Ravi (Onboarding): I'll build the test harness and validate event telemetry. Two asks: 1) sample event schema, 2) list of PII/PHI fields to redact.

Clara (Product): Acceptance criteria: a) events include request_id + model_version, b) metrics visible in the console (latency, error_rate), c) a short runbook for support. I'll send the event schema before EOD.

Diego (Success Lead): I'll monitor renewal-risk signals: pilot adoption rate and support ticket volume. Proposal: run a short NPS + product feedback survey at D+30.

Aisha (Solutions Eng): Perf targets proposal: P50 < 150ms, P90 < 350ms on median prompt length. We'll run a focused 4-hour perf window at D+18.

Noah (CSM): Draft timeline below. Flag blockers now.

D+0: kickoff + intros
D+3: staging creds + sample prompts
D+10: initial integration + smoke tests
D+18: perf window + tuning
D+25: acceptance tests + analytics verified
D+30: pilot launch (gradual ramp)
D+45: review + go/no-go for full launch

Ravi (Onboarding): Small blocker: our harness needs token rotation support. I'll prototype token refresh in 48h.

Aisha (Solutions Eng): If Marco can provide longer-lived token for the first run that helps. Noah can you ask?

Noah (CSM): Will request longer TTL token and confirm redaction fields.

OnboardBot: Reminder: upload kickoff notes to /onboards/lattice within 24h. Calendar invite set for 2026-06-03 14:00 UTC.

Diego (Success Lead): I'll prepare the pilot success metrics dashboard and share a template by Tue.

Clara (Product): Added: acceptance test owner is Product. Please add me to their staging project.

Aisha (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll post creds to #secure-keys and start the smoke tests once we have them.

Noah (CSM): Recap of owners: Noah = client comms & intro, Aisha = integration + perf, Ravi = harness & redaction, Clara = acceptance tests & events, Diego = health/dashboard + survey. If no objections I'll post the runbook and send the intro to Marco.

Diego (Success Lead): No objections. Going to wire the renewal-risk checklist into the runbook now.

Noah (CSM): Thanks team 1. I'll send the intro and move notes into the onboard folder after the intro.
